display.purpose: Empty states and first-run only. Rare.

title.purpose: Chat card title, section heading, dialog title.

body.purpose: Messages and reading content; cap measure 65-75ch.

label.purpose: UPPERCASE nav section labels and smallest metadata.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Chat cards and component frames resting on the board. The hairline ring separates; the shadow is a whisper.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Popovers, menus, the new-chat control, dialogs. Only while floating above peers.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions. No bounce, no elastic.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action in a context. Cedar Ember fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.68 0.145 45); color: oklch(0.18 0.012 60); font: 600 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.75 0.14 45); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.68 0.145 45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Default action. Surface Raised with a 1px line.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: oklch(0.25 0.013 60); color: oklch(0.93 0.008 75); font: 400 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.32 0.016 60); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.29 0.014 60); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.68 0.145 45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer Input
components.description: Signature input: an inset Canvas-Void field inside a Surface card.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" placeholder="Ask the agent, or sketch on the pad" />
components.css: .ds-input { background: oklch(0.16 0.010 60); color: oklch(0.93 0.008 75); font: 400 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.32 0.016 60); border-radius: 10px; width: 100%; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.55 0.014 60); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.68 0.145 45); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.68 0.145 45); }

components.name: Active Nav Item
components.description: Active rail/panel row: 2px Cedar Ember indicator + Surface Overlay row. The icon stays neutral.
components.css: .ds-nav { background: oklch(0.21 0.012 60); border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px; width: 220px; } .ds-nav-row { position: relative; color: oklch(0.69 0.014 65); font: 400 0.875rem ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 120ms; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: oklch(0.25 0.013 60); color: oklch(0.93 0.008 75); } .ds-nav-row.ds-active { background: oklch(0.29 0.014 60); color: oklch(0.93 0.008 75); } .ds-bar { position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: oklch(0.68 0.145 45); }

components.name: Section Label
components.description: Mono UPPERCASE section label, the machine's voice for grouping (PAGES, CANVASES).
components.css: .ds-label { color: oklch(0.69 0.014 65); font: 500 0.6875rem ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Tool-Call Chip
components.description: Signature component: a small mono chip naming an agent tool, with optional elapsed time. The instrument's heartbeat.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: oklch(0.25 0.013 60); color: oklch(0.69 0.014 65); font: 400 0.78rem ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', Menlo, monospace; padding: 3px 7px; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-chip-t { color: oklch(0.55 0.014 60); font-size: 0.6875rem; }

components.description: A chat session resting on the pad: Surface body, Raised header drag handle, Float elevation.

narrative.overview: cedarpad is a cedar drafting table under one warm work-light. The surface is a warm graphite that recedes like wood in shadow; the only thing that catches the light is what is live. Color belongs to the work on the pad, never to the frame around it. The chrome is a precise instrument: flat, quiet, tightly spaced, built from a single warm-neutral material so the pad's real color reads true against it. The name is the palette: cedar is warm, natural, and crafted, and the one accent is a cedar ember.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-graphite tinted-dark surfaces (hue 60, very low chroma), never #000.
A single cedar-ember accent that means one thing: live / active.
Tonal depth, not shadow depth. Lighter surface = closer to you.
Mono for labels and machine output; sans for human content.
Tight, varied spacing. The pad is the hierarchy; chrome never competes.

rules.name: The Cedar-Means-Live Rule
rules.body: Cedar Ember covers <=10% of any view and signals exactly one concept: active or live. Active nav, focus, primary action, agent-streaming. Never decorative.

rules.name: The True-Color Rule
rules.body: The chrome is near-achromatic on purpose so the pad's own colors read true. Never add a chroma-heavy chrome surface.

rules.name: The Who-Is-Talking Rule
rules.body: Mono is the machine's voice (labels, tools, code, data); sans is the human's (titles, messages, prose).

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Chrome planes are flat and separated by tone and a 1px line. A shadow is a response to floating above the pad, not a default.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: Cedar Ember never glows. Active state is a solid edge, a fill, or a 2px inner ring, never a blurred halo.

dos: Do build the chrome from the warm-graphite neutral ramp (hue 60) and treat Cedar Ember as a <=10% signal that means live.
Do convey depth by stepping the surface one tone lighter, and reserve shadows for things floating above the pad.
Do set machine output in mono and human content in sans.
Do keep a visible 2px Cedar Ember focus ring on every interactive control, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do vary spacing for rhythm using the 4px-based scale; let the pad be the loudest thing on screen.
donts: Don't use #000 or #fff; every neutral is tinted toward hue 60 (warm).
Don't fall back to the cool dark-tool cliche (steel-blue chrome, cyan accent, neon-on-black, glassmorphism, glowing or gradient accents).
Don't use Cedar Ember to decorate; it is reserved for active/live state only.

Don't use side-stripe accents wider than 1px, gradient text, the hero-metric template, or identical card grids. The one sanctioned exception is the 2px Cedar Ember active-nav indicator on the selected row/rail item/page; never a decorative edge on a card or callout.
Don't ship the consumer-rounded, SaaS-cheerful look. This is an instrument.
Don't preserve the rushed styles.css values; conform them to this spec.
